description:
Couldn't decide if I wanted something super casual or something arty for my PCT, in the end I decided on something more renaissance looking since my char looks like an older distinguished gentleman.

Not many notes on this one, the gear is all very easily accessible and aside from the boots it's all dyeable from the get go, but I didn't due them anyway. All the pieces bar the boots are cheap on the mb or easy to craft with older mats. Visor is off for the cap to use the headwear glasses.

description:
For this glam, I took a lot of inspiration from areas like Shaaloani. For some reason, the desert atmosphere immediately made me think about adding goggles, because of the sandstorms and that kind of explorer vibe.

The overall earthy color palette also gave me the right feeling for this Viper. Also, aren’t snakes usually associated with desert environments? I'm not entirely sure, but it felt like it matched the theme really well.
title: Shaaloani Viper

description:
I recently started my One Piece journey, and I've honestly become obsessed with it. I decided to make a Roronoa Zoro cosplay in the game.

The biggest challenge was finding something that matched the sash Zoro wears around his waist. After a lot of searching, I finally found the Picto pants, which worked surprisingly well.

It's a shame we don't have triple katanas, but the fact that we can use dual blades already adds a lot to the overall look. I think I managed to capture the style pretty well
title: Roronoa Zoro | Cosplay
